v2_rationale: V2 investigates whether execution-derived behavioral evidence (dynamic signatures of call patterns, branch coverage, allocation behavior) overcomes the structural-semantic inversion. Root cause: static structure is insensitive to small SC mutations (off-by-one, operator swap). Dynamic execution should expose behavioral differences invisible to static analysis.
assumptions: All v1 files frozen — no modifications permitted under any circumstances
v2 adds new directories only; imports from v1 without modification
Benchmark pairs_test.jsonl (744 pairs) is the evaluation set — used exactly once per baseline
